summary: Iteration 20 — validated Stripe card checkout end-to-end, /reprise/{order_id} cart recovery, About page + SEO titles, WhatsApp button hidden by design, real month-over-month trends on seller Dashboard, and full regression on Paxity config / products list / seller login. 11/11 backend pytest pass; 15/15 frontend UI assertions pass. critical_code_review_comments: stripe_router.py `_mark_paid` is properly idempotent via find_one_and_update on payment_status!=paid — good, safe against duplicate webhook + poll firing simultaneously.
Stripe fallback when automatic_tax is refused (InvalidRequestError) is clean; retries without automatic_tax silently. Consider logging the tax reason for future accounting.
_recovery_loop uses an atomic find_one_and_update claim (recovery_email_sent!=True) before send — correct multi-worker-safe pattern.
SellerContext trend calc: pct returns null when prev30 is empty — good, no fake data. When current 30d = 0 and prev30 > 0 the KPI shows -100% (mathematically correct, verified on live dashboard).
WhatsAppButton returns null when WHATSAPP_NUMBER is empty — matches the request, no floating button leaks.
usePageTitle hook sets document.title + meta[name=description] on mount — verified: /, /boutique/mode, /produit/p1 all get distinct titles.
orders_router.py exposes /api/orders but there's no pagination — 46+ real orders returned in a single payload; consider adding limit/skip for scale.
